___note: Fixture for tests/harness/discovery-askcard.spec.ts: a vague request must reach the human as a clarification card. Until bc8fe0ee (2026-10-08, 'make PIL background advice and let the leader convene council') that card came from PIL's discovery interview (createModelClarificationProposer). bc8fe0ee made PIL background-only and deliberately stopped passing a clarificationProposer/interactionHandler to it (pinned by src/orchestrator/__tests__/preprocessor-cancellation.test.ts 'records background phases without human questions'), so PIL can no longer ask anything; and since b014c9b9 the main agent is the orchestrator role that 'coordinates, plans, asks questions' (docs/investigations/orchestrator-only-2026-10-17.md). The clarification is therefore main's own ask_user tool call: stream round 0 is that call (the TUI renders it as id=askcard via setAskUserHandler and the tool BLOCKS until answered); round 1 is the ordinary reply, reached only once the card is answered. The classify call does NOT consume a round: loadMockModelFromDir sets autoClassify, so mock-model.ts answers it from its own intercept.
